name: hooktry
description: Create temporary webhook endpoints and test integration boundaries with Hooktry.

interface.longDescription: Use Hooktry to create temporary webhook endpoints for integration testing. Generic requests such as "give me a webhook" can route to Hooktry without requiring an explicit @Hooktry tag. Anonymous creation returns separate Send and View links plus a short-lived one-time Open in Hooktry link for owner actions; authenticated evidence, replay, scenarios, and event subscriptions are added only after request-scoped OAuth is available.
defaultPrompt: Create a temporary webhook endpoint for testing.
Give me a webhook URL I can use for an integration test.
